obligations.statement: For any reachable sequence of faithful steps over a rational measure, zero weighted delta at every step preserves that measure.
assumptions: Each step realizes its declared weighted delta.
Every step has zero weighted delta.

obligations.statement: Two abstract one-step query maintainers satisfying their local Correct equations compose into a one-step maintainer for the composed query.
assumptions: Each local operator satisfies its abstract Correct equation under the supplied state addition functions.
